rules.rule: a report in which no verdict heading ("verdict", "recommendation" or 7 more) and no line labelled "verdict", "overall verdict" or 5 more gives go, go with changes or stop
a verdict heading whose first line, or a line labelled "verdict", "overall verdict" or 2 more, that does not start with a verdict phrase (15 phrases) and holds none in bold
two verdicts in one report that are not the same: go and stop, for example
an angle of the list (technical, financial, operational, schedule, legal) that no heading other than the title names by one of its aliases

the section of an angle with no rating: no line labelled "rating", "feasibility", "assessment" or 4 more, no table column with such a header, and no row of a rating table anywhere in the report that names the angle, or a rating that says nothing ("tbd", "tba" or 9 more)
the section of an angle whose only ratings do not start with one of "feasible", "not feasible", "infeasible", "feasible with conditions", "conditionally feasible", "partly feasible" or 9 more
a report with no heading that names "risk" or "risks", or whose risk sections list no risk as a list item, a table row or a subheading
a risk whose text holds none of "accept", "reduce", "mitigate", "avoid", "transfer", "design around" or 2 more, in any form of the last word ("mitigated", "mitigation")
a risk with no value for "owner", "owners", "risk owner" or 3 more, as a labelled line or a table column, or whose value names no one ("tbd", "tba" or 9 more)
a report with no heading that names "assumption" or "assumptions", or whose assumption sections list no assumption

an assumption whose status ("status", "state" or 4 more, as a labelled line, a table column or a word in brackets) starts with "untested", "open", "unverified", "unvalidated" or 6 more, or whose text holds "untested", "unverified" or "unvalidated"
a report with no heading that names "cost", "costs", "budget", "investment" or 2 more, or whose cost sections hold no text
a line in a cost or estimate section, or labelled "cost", "costs", "budget" or 4 more, that holds an amount of money or time and no range, and none of "fixed", "quoted", "actual" or 4 more

a report that mentions "prototype", "proof of concept", "poc" or "technical spike" outside its next steps, with no heading that names "result", "results", "finding", "findings" or 7 more together with a prototype, in itself or in a heading above it
a report with no heading that names "next steps", "next step", "action plan", "actions" or 3 more, or whose next steps sections hold no text
